description:
Send an STL, 3MF or OBJ and get back its real size, volume, roughly how much plastic it needs, and whether it fits on one plate. Instant, no human involved, nothing is ordered.

Use this BEFORE submit_job whenever your human has a file. It catches the things that waste everyone's day — a part that is 340mm tall and has to be split, a file exported in inches so it arrives 25x too small, a mesh with no solid volume.

It does NOT return a price and never will. Orientation, supports and finishing decide the price and a person here decides those. Do not infer a price from the grams.

fileName.description: Including the extension — it decides how the file is read. STL, 3MF or OBJ. STEP cannot be measured.

material.description: PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, Nylon, PC. Only changes the weight estimate. Defaults to PLA.

name: check_geometry
title: Measure a model before anyone commits to it
